neighborhoods.name: Lancing
neighborhoods.notes: coastal town; varied residential stock from seafront Victorian to suburban post-war

property_mix.notable: Seaside residential character with significant Victorian and Edwardian housing stock alongside mid-20th century suburban expansion. Strong interwar and post-war council housing presence.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian seafront properties often feature original period locks and sash windows requiring specialist knowledge and care.
Post-war council estates and semis dominate outer Lancing; many use standard pin-tumbler and mortice locks prone to wear.
Coastal location means salt-air corrosion accelerates lock degradation; marine-grade or frequent maintenance calls are common in seafront areas.
